articles.text: FÙ TÀITAI: Huáng Kēzhǎng, Huáng Tàitai, huānyíng, huānyíng. Qǐng jìn.
MRS. FRANKLIN: Section Chief Huáng, Mrs. Huáng — welcome. Please come in.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Fù Tàitai, nín hǎo? Zhè shi yìdiǎn xiǎo yìsi.
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: How are you, Mrs. Franklin? Here is a small token of appreciation.
FÙ TÀITAI: Nín zhēn shi tài kèqi. Xièxie.
MRS. FRANKLIN: You are really too polite. Thank you.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Wǒ zhīdao nín xǐhuan shānshuǐ huà.
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: I know you like landscape paintings.
FÙ TÀITAI: Lái, wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshao jièshao. Zhèiwèi shi Hé Jiàoshòu, zài Táidà jiāo jīngjìxué.
MRS. FRANKLIN: Come, let me introduce you. This is Professor Hollins, who teaches economics at Taiwan University.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Jiǔyǎng, jiǔyǎng. Nín láile duō jiǔ le?
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: Glad to meet you. How long have you been here?
HÉ JIÀOSHÒU: Jiǔyǎng. Wǒ gāng lái liǎngge yuè. Hái yǒu hěn duō bù shóuxide dìfang.
PROFESSOR HOLLINS: Glad to meet you. I came only two months ago. There's still much I'm not familiar with.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Nǎli, nǎli. Xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhui duō jiànmiàn.
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: Not at all. I hope we'll have a chance to meet more in the future.
